title: Prove or Disprove Phase99 Architecture
method: Repository-only static analysis + consumer grep (no code changes, no backtest)
verdict_label: Hybrid — Phase99 partially useful; needs architectural refactor
one_line_answer: Phase9_9 model stays; phase99 dataset-merge inference is architecturally wrong — hybrid refactor to live FeatureBuilder required beyond dataset maintenance.

verdict_detail.verdict_label: Hybrid — Phase99 partially useful; needs architectural refactor

rejected.A: Not supported: repository shows ~8% merge coverage at best (sparse events), fillna(0) on 92%+ bars, and FeatureBuilder bypass — not solvable by dataset refresh alone.
rejected.B: Not supported: phase9_9 frozen model and EngineRegistry RANGE routing are production mandatory; cannot delete phase99 path without replacing range engine entirely.

partially_useful: Frozen phase9_9 model + 3 features remain valid RANGE engine artifacts
phase99_* prefix correctly isolates range-training features from trend columns
Training pipeline (FeatureBuilder → sparse dataset) is coherent
needs_refactor: Inference must not rely on dataset_v2 left-merge for every M5 bar
Live FeatureBuilder.compute_at (already in RangeEngineAdapter fallback) should be primary inference source with training parity validation
fillna(0) merge policy is incorrect default for live inference
why_C.recommended_future_direction: Approved production phase: live FeatureBuilder overlay at inference (22J-005 concept) WITHOUT retraining model until parity proven — separate from dataset maintenance (22N/O).
